note: 近代 is history before 现代 (contemporary); 近代史 = modern history.

examples.zh: 他在研究中国近代历史。
examples.en: He is studying China's modern history.

examples.zh: 这座楼是近代建的。
examples.en: This building was built in the modern period.

examples.zh: 近代以来，城市变化很大。
examples.en: Since modern times, cities have changed a lot.

note: Idiom, used as a modifier: 五颜六色的 + noun.

examples.zh: 公园里开着五颜六色的花。
examples.en: Colorful flowers are blooming in the park.

examples.zh: 孩子们穿着五颜六色的衣服。
examples.en: The children are wearing clothes of every color.

examples.zh: 这家店的糖五颜六色，很好看。
examples.en: The candy in this shop is colorful and looks lovely.

note: 暑假 is the summer vacation; 放寒假 = the winter break starts.

examples.zh: 下周我们就放寒假了。
examples.en: We start our winter break next week.

examples.zh: 寒假你打算去哪儿？
examples.en: Where are you planning to go for winter break?

examples.zh: 今年的寒假只有三周。
examples.en: This year's winter break is only three weeks.

examples.zh: 你有尺子吗？借我用一下。
examples.en: Do you have a ruler? Let me borrow it.

examples.zh: 他用尺子量了量桌子。
examples.en: He measured the table with a ruler.

examples.zh: 这把尺子有三十厘米长。
examples.en: This ruler is thirty centimeters long.

note: Sold in bottles in China; 矿泉水 is mineral water.

examples.zh: 请给我一瓶纯净水。
examples.en: Please give me a bottle of purified water.

examples.zh: 我平时喝纯净水，不喝果汁。
examples.en: I usually drink purified water, not juice.

examples.zh: 冰箱里有纯净水吗？
examples.en: Is there bottled water in the fridge?

meaning: marks a fraction: 三分之一 = one third

senses.en: marks a fraction: 三分之一 = one third

note: Pattern: denominator + 分之 + numerator, so 三分之一 = 1/3.

examples.zh: 三分之一的学生来自外地。
examples.en: One third of the students come from other places.

examples.zh: 他吃了四分之三的苹果。
examples.en: He ate three quarters of the apples.

examples.zh: 这个月的工资我存了二分之一。
examples.en: I saved half of this month's salary.

examples.zh: 亚运会在北京举行过。
examples.en: The Asian Games have been held in Beijing.

examples.zh: 你看昨天的亚运会比赛了吗？
examples.en: Did you watch yesterday's Asian Games match?

examples.zh: 他想参加下次亚运会。
examples.en: He wants to take part in the next Asian Games.

note: Separable verb; 填空题 = fill-in-the-blank question.

examples.zh: 请在这里填空。
examples.en: Please fill in the blank here.

examples.zh: 这道填空题我不会。
examples.en: I can't do this fill-in-the-blank question.

examples.zh: 考试有选择题和填空题。
examples.en: The exam has multiple-choice and fill-in-the-blank questions.

meaning: class hours; credit hours (hours of instruction)

senses.en: class hours; credit hours (hours of instruction)

note: Used for course length: 共三十个学时 = 30 class hours in total.

examples.zh: 这门课一共有四十个学时。
examples.en: This course has forty class hours in total.

examples.zh: 一个学时是四十五分钟。
examples.en: One class hour is forty-five minutes.

examples.zh: 培训一共需要多少学时？
examples.en: How many class hours does the training need in total?

meaning: to put on (clothes), to get dressed in

senses.en: to put on (clothes), to get dressed in

note: 穿上 stresses the action of putting on; 穿着 is the state of wearing.

examples.zh: 外面冷，快穿上外套。
examples.en: It's cold outside, put your coat on quickly.

examples.zh: 他穿上鞋就出门了。
examples.en: He put on his shoes and went out.

examples.zh: 你穿上这件衣服一定很好看。
examples.en: You'll certainly look good in this piece of clothing.

note: Verb here; as a noun it means translator or interpreter, but this entry is the verb.

examples.zh: 请把这句话翻译成英文。
examples.en: Please translate this sentence into English.

examples.zh: 这个词怎么翻译？
examples.en: How do you translate this word?

examples.zh: 我想请你帮我翻译一下。
examples.en: I'd like to ask you to translate this for me.

note: Short for 高速铁路; 坐高铁 = to take the high-speed train.

examples.zh: 坐高铁去上海要几个小时？
examples.en: How many hours does the high-speed train to Shanghai take?

examples.zh: 我买了明天早上的高铁票。
examples.en: I bought a high-speed train ticket for tomorrow morning.

examples.zh: 高铁站离这里远吗？
examples.en: Is the high-speed rail station far from here?

note: 把 A 和 B 隔开 = to separate A from B.

examples.zh: 一堵墙把两个房间隔开了。
examples.en: A wall separates the two rooms.

examples.zh: 把生的和熟的东西隔开放。
examples.en: Keep raw and cooked food apart.

examples.zh: 河把这个城市隔开了。
examples.en: The river divides the city.

note: Often opens a sentence expressing surprise: 没想到……

examples.zh: 没想到你也在这里！
examples.en: I never expected you to be here too!

examples.zh: 我没想到他会来。
examples.en: I didn't think he would come.

examples.zh: 没想到路上这么堵，我迟到了。
examples.en: Who knew traffic would be so bad, I was late.

note: Spoken form of 名牌; 穿名牌 = wear designer brands.

examples.zh: 她喜欢买名牌儿的包。
examples.en: She likes buying designer-brand bags.

examples.zh: 这件衣服不是名牌儿，但是很好看。
examples.en: This piece isn't a famous brand, but it looks nice.

examples.zh: 你为什么总买名牌儿？
examples.en: Why do you keep buying brand names?

examples.zh: 她想当模特儿。
examples.en: She wants to be a model.

examples.zh: 这位模特儿个子很高。
examples.en: This model is very tall.

examples.zh: 他姐姐在北京做模特儿。
examples.en: His older sister works as a model in Beijing.

note: 发微信 = send a WeChat message; 微信号 = WeChat ID.

examples.zh: 我给你发微信吧。
examples.en: I'll send you a WeChat message.

examples.zh: 加一下我的微信，好吗？
examples.en: Add my WeChat, okay?

examples.zh: 他没回我的微信。
examples.en: He didn't reply to my WeChat message.

note: Also 下个星期 / 下个周 for next week.

examples.zh: 我下个月去上海工作。
examples.en: I'm going to work in Shanghai next month.

examples.zh: 下个月房租要变吗？
examples.en: Is the rent changing next month?

examples.zh: 考试不在这个月，在下个月。
examples.en: The exam isn't this month, it's next month.

examples.zh: 我马上下楼，你等我。
examples.en: I'm coming downstairs right away, wait for me.

examples.zh: 他下楼去买早饭了。
examples.en: He went downstairs to buy breakfast.

examples.zh: 你能下楼接一下快递吗？
examples.en: Can you go downstairs and pick up the parcel?

note: Often used in the negative: 没劲儿 = no energy / boring.

examples.zh: 他很有劲儿，一个人搬得动。
examples.en: He is strong and can move it alone.

examples.zh: 今天我不太有劲儿，想休息。
examples.en: I don't have much energy today, I want to rest.

examples.zh: 这个游戏真有劲儿！
examples.en: This game is really fun!
